text.style: font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 8.5px; fill: rgb(108, 117, 125); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: 10 of 10 modes clear the benchmark's fixed threshold (success rate 1.00). Each bar runs from a mode's threshold to the mean of
100 greedy episodes of the final policy, so its length and direction are the margin. The pale line is ±1 s.d. across those
episodes, which is the spread of play, not the uncertainty on the mean: at n=100 that uncertainty is a tenth of it, so every pass and fail
here is decisive. The axis does not start at zero. Modes are in learning order. Seed 0.
